O5.statement: For every allowed input and row (g,k), if count(g,k)>0 then value(g,k)=sum(g,k). If count(g,k)=0 and fill=none then value(g,k)=null. Previous state is group-local, initially null, updated by every nonempty bucket including a zero sum, unchanged by empty buckets, and never seeded by events before start.
